reasoning_content:
The admin menu is present. The earlier admin page returned "Qisutu login" because I used ?Step= instead of ?Page=. Let me fetch a few real admin pages with the authenticated session to confirm functionality. Also LDAP, SMTP, Forms, KB etc mentioned in guide.

Let me test a few key admin pages: AdminLDAP, AdminSMTPAccount, AdminPostmasterIMAPAccounts, and a customer portal login page.

action.command: cd /tmp; for p in AdminLDAP AdminSMTPAccount AdminPostmasterIMAPAccounts AdminQueues AdminForms AdminKnowledgeBase AdminAPI AdminSystemSettings; do code=$(curl -s -b cj2.txt -o /tmp/p_$p.html -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost/qisutu/index.pl?Page=$p"); t=$(grep -oiE '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/p_$p.html | head -1); echo "$p -> $code $t"; done

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /tmp; for p in AdminLDAP AdminSMTPAccount AdminPostmasterIMAPAccounts AdminQueues AdminForms AdminKnowledgeBase AdminAPI AdminSystemSettings; do code=$(curl -s -b cj2.txt -o /tmp/p_$p.html -w \"%{http_code}\" \"http://localhost/qisutu/index.pl?Page=$p\"); t=$(grep -oiE '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/p_$p.html | head -1); echo \"$p -> $code $t\"; done", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Test key admin pages with authenticated session"}
